title: CSV Data Processing
description: Write rows to a CSV file using the csv module, then read and print them back.
code:
import csv

rows = [["name", "score"], ["Asha", "88"], ["Ravi", "74"]]

with open("scores.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerows(rows)

with open("scores.csv", "r", newline="") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    for row in reader:
        print(row)
